title: Vivian Tu | Rich AF: The Winning Money Mindset That Will Change Your Life | Talks at Google
description:
YouTube creator, TikTok star and former Wall Street trader Vivian Tu discusses her book Rich AF: The Winning Money Mindset That Will Change Your Life, a guide equipped with the tools and knowledge to not only help you understand the financial landscape, but to build a financial strategy of your own.

Get the book here: https://goo.gle/3TOu5VT
For more information on Vivian, please visit https://www.yourrichbff.com/ or her TikTok page, https://www.tiktok.com/@yourrichbff.

Vivian Tu is a former Wall Street trader-turned-expert, educator, public speaker, host, entrepreneur, media powerhouse and the founder and CEO of the financial equity phenomenon, “Your Rich BFF.” In January 2021, she developed and launched the “Your Rich BFF” blog and social media handles as a passion project to destigmatize and make the rules of personal finance accessible and digestible to non-experts and marginalized communities. Her dedication to promoting financial literacy and ability to bridge the gap between finance and the mainstream have earned her cross-platform fame and notoriety, having garnered nearly 6 million followers and counting, as well as honors on both the Forbes’ ‘30 Under 30 – Social Media’ (2023) and inaugural ‘Top Creators’ (2022) lists.

Moderated by Sonali Karmarkar.
